format_coverage: The real Cloud Digital Leader exam uses two item formats: multiple choice and multiple select. Mockka supports three, so this exam's format profile is a SUBSET of what the player can render rather than an excess — nothing about the real paper goes unrepresented. Multiple choice maps exactly to single_choice; multiple select maps to multiple_response, and Mockka scores it all-or-nothing. Mockka's third format, scenario_matching, has NO counterpart on the real exam and is set to zero throughout: you will not be asked to map scenarios onto a reused option set when you sit the real paper. Two limits you should know about. First, Google publishes no per-format count, and its own free sample-question set is 100% single choice — so the real share of multiple-select items is unpublished and unobserved, and the split used here is Mockka's judgment, not a vendor figure. Second, the real exam is delivered as 50-60 questions in 90 minutes and Google does not publish a passing score (results are pass/fail only); this mock is built to the published upper bound of 60 items and applies a Mockka-chosen pass threshold, which is a study aid and not a prediction of the real result.

Distilled to derivation/source-gcp-cdl-guide.md.

Official Cloud Digital Leader certification page, Google LLC (cloud.google.com/learn/certification/cloud-digital-leader), read 2026-08-16. Public page; supplies the logistics the exam guide omits — 50-60 questions, 90 minutes, 99 USD, five languages, online- or onsite-proctored, no prerequisites, three-year validity, and the two item formats. Logistics only; no concepts, so no derivation document.

Google LLC, official free Cloud Digital Leader sample questions (29 items), published as a public Google Form linked from the certification page; read 2026-08-16 without an account or a submission. Used under the clean-room rule for analytical classification only — per-item concept mapping and distractor-pattern frequencies in derivation/source-gcp-cdl-samples.md. No text reused, and no answer key was available or taken.

provenance.nda_statement: This package contains no live exam content. Nothing here is drawn from the Cloud Digital Leader item bank, and no question reproduces an item encountered in a real sitting. Actual exam content is confidential under the Google Cloud certification exam terms a candidate accepts before testing; sources whose items trace back to candidate recall of a live sitting were screened out at intake and are listed with evidence in derivation/sources.md.
